_comment: ONE table, two implementations. check-image-weight.mjs (the build gate) and optimize-images.py (the converter) must agree on which files are exempt from the webp rule, and they are written in different languages, so they drift silently. They did: JS RegExp.test searches, Python re.match anchors at the start, and the same pattern classified docusaurus-social-card.jpg as exempt in the gate and convertible in the converter. The converter won, and eleven wikis had their social card turned into a webp that several unfurl consumers do not render. Both scripts self-test against this table before they do anything.
